caption: The drawing is composed of a central octagonal floral motif surrounded by a series of rectangular border patterns. The central motif contains a symmetrical flower with several layers of petals radiating outward from a detailed circular center. Around the octagon are arrangements of stylized leaves, vines, and floral shapes, with smaller decorative elements such as dots and short lines filling the spaces between the main forms. Four thick rectangular borders flank the octagonal centerpiece, each featuring repeating stylized floral designs with curved lines and symmetrical arrangements. Additionally, there are smaller, shorter rectangular border elements at the corners, displaying variations of the curved leaf and vine motifs. The drawing is executed in black ink on a beige or off-white background, giving it a sharp contrast, and lines of varying thickness are used to create definition and decorative detail in the patterns. No other colors are present in the composition.
title: Connecticut-type Hadley Chest-Detail of Central Panel
